creative_direction: Create a composed Kotaro Katsura portrait with long straight black hair framing his familiar adult face. He wears a plain light robe over a blue inner collar and lightly gathers one hair section at shoulder level. Keep both eyes fully visible and the mouth in a small neutral smile. Use graphic indigo, ivory, and muted warm-gray blocks, with the hair divided into broad clear masses rather than many strands. The head remains nearly frontal while the shoulders turn slightly. Keep the silhouette centered and dignified, without theatrical costume details, companion characters, or a complete background environment. Use gentle rose-violet concentric iris rings around clear dark pupils, with bright catchlights. A pale moon disc sits behind the portrait as a quiet background shape, suggesting Infinite Tsukuyomi without changing the expression. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
